PTE5 p. 17 (random variables on D in F with values in R*)
components.gap: Two source variants are missing on the route: (a) Durrett's extended random variable is a function on a set D in F with values in R* = [-inf, inf], measurable for the Borel sets of R* under its usual topology (generated by [-inf,a), (a,b), (b,inf]); the entry defines extended variables only on all of Omega with the sigma-algebra generated by [-inf,a] and does not show that this is the Borel sigma-algebra of that topology; (b) Durrett defines almost sure convergence by P(Omega_o) = 1 with Omega_o the set where the limit exists, with no prescribed limit, and notes it is called almost everywhere convergence in measure theory; the entry defines only almost sure convergence to a specified real random variable.
